research_question: Can published Gaussian-map navigation and filtering be reproduced?
expected_contribution: A reproducible baseline and honest system boundary
implementation: Reproduction harnesses, protocol locks, runtime repairs, G0/G1 checks
positive_result: Published pipelines were recovered and bounded static/runtime checks became repeatable
negative_result: End-to-end success was not uniform across maps; several failures were protocol or geometry failures
falsified_assumption: Compatibility or a smoke test is not formal navigation success
still_valid: Reproduction assets and failure taxonomy remain usable
forbidden_claim: No universal safe-navigation or cross-dataset success claim

research_question: Can active-set filtering reduce SAFER query cost?
implementation: Risk-aware candidate filters, ablations, BestD selection
positive_result: Constraint/query reduction and efficiency signals were observed
negative_result: No new safety benefit was established
falsified_assumption: Efficiency improvement is not a safety improvement

research_question: When is a Gaussian map admissible for navigation claims?
implementation: Map provenance, scale, coordinate, reference, and split audits
positive_result: Fail-closed qualification exposed which assets can support which claims
negative_result: Most learned maps lacked two-map reference-complete evaluation
falsified_assumption: Photorealism or import success does not establish navigation geometry
still_valid: Protocol V2 and reference hierarchy remain central
forbidden_claim: No deployment qualification for failed maps

research_question: Can a learned Splatfacto map preserve metric navigation geometry?
expected_contribution: A trained TUM baseline with usable safety geometry
implementation: Formal training lineage, checkpoint audit, geometry refinement ablations
positive_result: Training and rendering were recovered; causes of several runtime failures were identified
negative_result: Post-3K geometry drift and map/reference mismatch prevented formal navigation use
falsified_assumption: Good rendering metrics do not imply trustworthy collision geometry
forbidden_claim: TUM Splatfacto is not a formal navigation map

research_question: Do dedicated RGB-D Gaussian SLAM maps improve metric geometry?
implementation: Adapters, metric-pose audits, static SAFER queries
positive_result: Dedicated RGB-D frontends improved provenance and compatibility understanding
negative_result: No two-independent-map claim-ready reference split emerged
falsified_assumption: A loadable map is not a qualified cross-map benchmark
forbidden_claim: No broad mapping or navigation superiority

research_question: Why do nominal direct-goal trials stall or start unsafe?
implementation: Direct-safe pair search, projection and geometric root-cause tools
positive_result: Separated initial infeasibility from later controller limitation
negative_result: Some candidate schedules never reached the intended activation regime
falsified_assumption: A failed trajectory can be an invalid scenario rather than a controller verdict
paper_usable_evidence: No method superiority from inadmissible trials

research_question: Do continuous barrier checks survive sampled execution?
implementation: Float64 boundary certification, Hessian calibration, sampled-step audits
positive_result: Numerical contracts and boundary-event certifications were established
falsified_assumption: Continuous certificates do not automatically imply sampled-data safety

research_question: Can predictive trigger/recovery avoid boundary stalls?
implementation: V4-C trigger, HCE recovery, preregistered pair schedules
positive_result: Specific development/heldout cases reached the trigger and recovery logic
negative_result: Representative progress and overlap were too limited; paired20 was paused after two results
falsified_assumption: Stress-case activation cannot replace representative prevalence
paper_usable_evidence: No full 20-pair or general navigation claim

research_question: Which submodules have support independent of the full stack?
implementation: Evidence traceability, claim matrices, component audits
positive_result: Positive and negative evidence became auditable by module
negative_result: The evidence did not compose into an automatic end-to-end guarantee
falsified_assumption: Module validity does not imply system validity

research_question: What is the smallest coherent FAS-CBF core?
expected_contribution: Actuator-bounded swept, terminal, and alternative semantics
implementation: State machine, certificate schema, theory obligations, interfaces
positive_result: A coherent fail-closed executable contract was frozen
negative_result: Several proof obligations remain empirical or open
falsified_assumption: Conceptual closure is not empirical qualification
reusable_evaluation: Problem formulation and bounded design evidence

research_question: Can the Core V1 contract be executed with typed outcomes?
implementation: Nested method matrix, represented-space alternatives, failure typing
positive_result: Executable semantics and nested ablations were validated
negative_result: Representative activation was not demonstrated at this stage
falsified_assumption: Passing unit and method tests is not representative utility
paper_usable_evidence: No broad replacement or learned-map claim

workstream: Replica GT activated and representative benchmark
research_question: Does Core V1 activate and help, and how prevalent is that need?
expected_contribution: Causal B0-B3 evidence plus a representative prevalence audit
implementation: 100 activated states, 160 representative holdout states, 1040 one-step records, 640 episodes
data_maps: Replica GT-derived Gaussian plus independent mesh
positive_result: Activated G0-G5 quotas were met and the mechanism was exercised without represented false-safe events
negative_result: Representative segment, backup, and directional activation were 0/160; B3 missed 50 ms on 116/260 one-step records
falsified_assumption: 0/160 is not method failure, but pressure cases cannot overwrite it
reusable_code: Qualified Replica map and reference mesh
reusable_data: Nested paired benchmark and reference oracle
reusable_evaluation: Strongest current mechanism and limitation evidence
paper_usable_evidence: No broad real-time SAFER replacement; no collision superiority from zero reference-collision events
